chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Musa, from one of our companions, raising it to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), that he said:
I do not know for the toxins any cure more beneficial than a suweeq (a type of porridge or soft food) of apples.

key_terms.سَوِيقِ: suweeq, a soft food or porridge made from grain and fruit

ai.seo_question: What is the best cure for poisons according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) identifies apple porridge (*suweeq*) as the most potent antidote for poisons, reflecting the Shia tradition of *al-Tibb al-Nabawi* (Prophetic Medicine) which emphasizes natural remedies. This specific endorsement underscores the apple's status not merely as a fruit, but as a comprehensive medicinal agent capable of neutralizing toxins, a view supported by later Shia physicians like Ibn al-Haytham.
